title: Ternium Q1 2026 results
excerpt: Q1 2026 parent-attributable profit was USD 213 million, or USD 1.09 per ADS; operating cash flow was USD 217 million and capex was USD 406 million.
summary: The current SEC-filed quarterly evidence supports Ternium identity, parent-attributable earnings, cash conversion, balance-sheet risk, Pesqueria ramp analysis, and bounded valuation inputs. No newer quarterly results were available before the canonical July 28 market observation.
